# The Token Dad

> A dad automating his way out of the overwhelm — and publishing what it costs. This file points AI answer engines and LLM crawlers at the canonical, machine-readable pages of the site.

## The Website Challenge (v1)

One person wrote a website design brief once, then froze it. Four AI design tools each built the same site from that identical brief, varying nothing but the tool. The headline finding: typography was left deliberately open, yet all four tools independently chose Archivo for display type — six independent readings of the same vision produced one typeface. The four exhibits are frozen, noindex builds; these hub pages are the canonical explanation and ranking.

- [Website Challenge — overview](https://thetoken.dad/website-challenge-v1/): What the challenge was, the headline finding, the four exhibits, and answers to common questions (cost, fonts, whether a pricier process builds a better site).
- [Methodology](https://thetoken.dad/website-challenge-v1/methodology/): The control surface (one variable: the tool), clean-context runners, the intake-proxy mechanism, parallel execution, and orchestrator-side verification.
- [Results](https://thetoken.dad/website-challenge-v1/results/): The full headline finding, process-not-taste divergence, the single most valuable defect (a colour that could never render), the design and deployment stats tables, and the honest cost method.
- [Exhibits](https://thetoken.dad/website-challenge-v1/exhibits/): The four AI design tools compared — per-tool process, per-arm stats, caveats, and links to each frozen build.

## Key facts (grounded, non-invented)

- All four AI design tools chose Archivo for display type, independently.
- Cheapest complete build: frontend-design at a modelled $1.12; most expensive: Impeccable at $7.02 (a 6x spread).
- Modelled total across four tools plus deployment: about $14.16 (token counts measured; cost modelled at a 92% input / 8% output split; plausible range $11–$54).
- Tools compared: frontend-design (Claude's design skill), Impeccable, Taste (design-taste-frontend), gstack (design-consultation → design-review).

## Notes

- The exhibit subdomains (claude-design-v1, claude-impeccable-v1, claude-taste-v1, claude-gstack-v1 .thetoken.dad) are noindex and may not be crawlable; the hub pages above carry the canonical record.
